Made from lightweight cotton gauze, this pajama set is designed for breathability and all-day comfort, perfect for hot and humid weather.

🌿 Why You’ll Love It

☁️ Soft Cotton Gauze Fabric

Lightweight and airy texture that feels gentle on skin, with a natural, relaxed drape.

❄️ Cooling & Breathable

Allows airflow to keep you cool and dry – ideal for Singapore’s climate.

🛋️ Relaxed Fit for Everyday Comfort

Loose-cut design for easy movement, whether you’re sleeping or lounging at home.

✨ Minimal & Clean Aesthetic

Timeless neutral tones and subtle texture for a calm, cozy homewear look.

🧵 Thoughtful Details

Button-up short sleeve top

Elastic waistband for flexible fit

Side pockets

Soft-touch fabric with textured finish

🌡️ Perfect For

Sleeping in aircon rooms

Relaxing at home

Casual indoor wear

Hot & humid weather

🧼 Care Instructions

Machine wash cold

Do not bleach

Tumble dry low or air dry

aiTexts: The Maternity Clothing Summer Cotton Japanese-style Kimono Pajamas are designed for comfort and style during the breastfeeding phase.
Crafted from soft, breathable cotton, these pajamas ensure a cozy fit for new mothers.

  • Beautiful lace Seaming design.
